name: Gryddle
summary: Amazon filament brand selling PLA, high-speed PLA and PETG, mostly in 10-16 kg multi-colour bundles at about $7-9/kg (single 1 kg PETG $9.47-16.99). The Amazon seller is a Jingmen trading company; extruder unknown.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: 2 kg black ($8/kg), 10 kg black/white ($6.99/kg) and 16-colour 16 kg bundles ($8.12-9.31/kg).

product_lines.name: PETG
product_lines.notes: 1 kg $9.47-16.99; 10/12/16 kg bundles $7.45-8.90/kg. Variant names on the tracker cite diameter tolerances from 0.03 to 0.20 mm, which look like listing data errors.

additional_notes: Legal entity: Jingmenshihuanxumaoyiyouxiangongsi (Business Name as printed; Jingmen Huanxu Trading Co., Ltd. is a rendering), Duodao District, Jingmen, Hubei; Amazon seller 'Gryddle' (id A28V1Z0Q8V7IUY), read 2026-11-06. The listing's Manufacturer field reads 'Gryddle'. Store is Amazon only; no brand website found. The entity is a trading company, so the extruder is unknown.
